description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-07 (via CTO DISPATCH). Load-bearing CVO finding (S7): the plane is ~70-80% ALREADY BUILT (C1 exists as CloudNode/CloudEdge in Nessie/Kuzu; 2 live compilers; 5 shipped observers) -> every component PRD is scoped UNIFY/GENERALIZE/WIRE, NOT build. Shared runnable acceptance instrument = comp-ladder (org/modules/graph/comp_ladder.py, BUILT 2026-07-07, proven on real estate: MultiFirmIsolation C3 decompresses losslessly to iam.tf:L199-208). The charter's job: the 5 component PRDs COMPOSE not collide (horizontal FEDOBS vs vertical MOTIF cut; the explicit-promotion boundary). PRD docs/architecture/NFRA_SEMCTL_PRD.md.
phase: CLOSED COMPLETE 2026-07-09 (2-step atomic, 2.0.0_SA_COO) on CTO's ruling 205745Z. The promote-fold's close condition -- one real, non-CVO-authored promotion, end-to-end, that SURVIVES -- evaluates TRUE against the CANONICAL STORE. 0.8.0 read `iceberg.globgrph.cse` file-level (342 rows / 58 parquet files; bound stated and discharged: an orphan file can only ADD rows, so a zero-empty result is safe in the direction that matters): exactly ONE row for `recognizer:silent-display-fork` -- verb=create, event_date=2026-07-08, execution_meta.timestamp='2026-07-08T15:21:00Z', run_id=CTO-PROMOTE-20260708T1521Z-silent-display-fork. NO delete row for that subject anywhere. `promote_recognizer_manifest.json` (named critical surface) reads state=MATERIALIZED. The promotion stands. PROVENANCE OF THE ERROR, recorded because it is the project's real lesson: THREE agents adjudicated this project against a LOSSY PROJECTION and each built a different wrong conclusion on it. CVO (verdict 3/3) read org/modules/graph/promote_materialize_cse.jsonl -- an UNTRACKED scratch file -- and concluded 'every promotion carries commission_id=CVO-EXERCISE, net-DEREGISTERED'. COO read the same scratch file and concluded the inverse: 'CVO's harness authored the demotion and consumed the artifact the close condition asks us to observe' -- elegant, adopted into doctrine by CTO, and false. CTO specified a close condition ('SURVIVES / net-REGISTERED') that was unfalsifiable in that artifact because it carried no timestamps. All three were reasoning about a projection whose DELETE events never landed in the canonical log. The filename said `_cse.jsonl`; the real trail is `promote_materializER_cse.jsonl` (git-tracked, c61f3b11c) and the real STORE is `iceberg.globgrph.cse`, which DOES carry execution_meta.timestamp. CVO retracted; COO retracted in full; CTO re-specified against the store and it evaluates TRUE. GOING FORWARD: CVO certifies against `iceberg.globgrph.cse`, NEVER the projection, and its own CVO-EXERCISE events are excluded from the evidence (author != judge). Gate candidate routed to CTO: an adjudication that grounds a ruling must cite a git-TRACKED path; untracked = scratch = cannot ground a close, a cert, or a retraction. FORWARD-RISK, not a gate: the git-tracked trail's events omit execution_meta though cse_schema DEFINES it as OPTIONAL and they carry schema_validated=true -- a validator certifying an event valid while the field required to order it is absent. Not blocking; the canonical store carries the timestamp.
materialize_producer_contract: SEMCTL MATERIALIZE-PRODUCER CONTRACT (CTO ruling 2026-07-18, from the A+B applied-gap @78a5fddbe; filed by COO 2026-07-18 -- NFRA_SEMCTL is the primary home as the semctl materialize-PRODUCER contract; cross-ref'd from NFRA_ONTOLOGY_AB_MATERIALIZE_SPEC, the materialize that exposed the seam; 0.7.0 documents these at point-of-use in the producer code, this record is the discoverable doctrine complement). (1) CANONICAL-ID RESOLUTION: a materialize's cross-layer CONTAINS (and any node-reference) targets ARE canonical ids (the committed graph identity = comp-kuzu node_id = ARN-if-present-else-node_id). The producer MUST resolve targets against the canonical id-space, NEVER the derive's short-form in-memory ids. The emit is authored in canonical ids; a producer resolving an intermediate id-space silently drops the edges whose ids diverge (estate types: EC2/LAMBDA/IAM/DDB/EVENT short-form vs ARN). (2) MANDATORY EDGE-FORMATION DENOMINATOR: the producer MUST print edges_resolved=X/Y (Z%) and LOUD-WARN when Z<100%. A materialize that silently drops edges is a DEFECT. Every miss is resolved (fix) OR explicitly accounted as legit drift (deleted/renamed target) -- never silently absent. (3) SELF-TEST CONTROL: the offline self-test uses a GENERATED negative control (present-set id-ONLY -> assert estate-ARN edges FAIL; id+ARN -> assert PASS). Injected/synthetic targets measure the author, not the instrument -- they cannot catch an in-derive id-space divergence. PROVENANCE: A+B (first estate-targeting materialize) exposed a pre-existing producer seam (79% edges, ~1062 absent); the debt materialize had the same latent seam, hidden because its targets were short-id-resolvable. NOTE: this contract is an addendum to the CLOSED charter -- it does NOT reopen the project; it is standing governance the semctl charter carries forward.
